text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Pierre Mauroy, head of the International Socialist, visits Morocco
- 50th anniversary of late king Mohammed V's visit to Tangier is an event which takes on particular importance.
- European Union delegation arrives to Morocco to hold talks over disbursement of financial aid to Morocco in the framework of the European MEDA programme.
- Opposition Istiqlal party holds leadership meeting on Saturday to prepare for elections.
- Ali Yata, head of the Socialism and Progress Party, hails as major political achievement the main opposition parties' agreement to field common candidates.
- Morocco to open a Moroccan-German chamber of commerce in Casablanca. German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt due to attend the inauguration ceremony.
